viirs_reference: Suomi NPP VIIRS (Feb 2012 - Oct 2026). NOAA-20/Suomi NPP ratio measured on 2018-2025 (sum ratio 1.033, monthly median 1.007) for continuing the series after 2 Nov 2026; not yet applied.
notes: Trained 2012-2020, tested on unseen 2021-2025: MODIS translated to the Suomi NPP scale vs real Suomi NPP, monthly totals. Single 0.25-degree cells (the harmonization grid; the site map sums them into 1-degree cells) are noisier (few hotspots per cell). Winter months before 2012 are noisy (few MODIS detections x large coefficients). 2026 is preliminary (near-real-time data). Months with Suomi NPP outages (e.g. late Jul-early Aug 2022, Jul 2024) are not normalized for observing days and look like low-fire months; without the three such test months, Ukraine R2 is 0.98 and bias -0.7 %.
